item.text: {"cost_regression":false,"evidence":{"O1":{"citation":"“Re-run all golden cases—A, B, and C” and require that “A and C still pass.”","status":"pass"},"O2":{"citation":"The artifact requires “one fresh, context-free runner per case” and says artifacts are “independently judged,” but it specifies no repeated trials and does not explicitly require a separate evidence-based judge for each trial.","status":"fail"},"O3":{"citation":"Evidence is missing: the artifact calls for only “one fresh, context-free runner per case” and provides no repetitions or per-case pass rates.","status":"fail"},"O4":{"citation":"Evidence is missing for diagnosing any new miss as a skill defect versus a bad case and for repeating a diagnose-revise-full-sweep loop.","status":"fail"},"O5":{"citation":"The report must show “the before/after movement: previously A/C passed and B failed; after the edit, A/B/C pass,” with “the original cited gap demonstrably resolved.”","status":"pass"},"S1":{"citation":"Smell absent: it explicitly says, “Re-run all golden cases—A, B, and C,” rather than rerunning only B.","status":"pass"},"S2":{"citation":"Smell absent: it requires “one fresh, context-free runner per case” and that each runner sees “only its case input.”","status":"pass"},"S3":{"citation":"Smell absent: artifacts are described as “independently judged”; the artifact does not direct runners to judge their own output.","status":"pass"},"S4":{"citation":"Smell absent: the proposed report gives case-specific outcomes—“A/B/C pass”—rather than only an aggregate score, although it fails O3 because it provides no repeated-trial rates.","status":"pass"},"S5":{"citation":"Smell absent: success requires that “A and C still pass, showing the B-specific edit caused no regressions.”","status":"pass"}},"passed":false,"rationale":"The artifact correctly requires a full A/B/C regression sweep with fresh context-free runners and legible before/after case results. It does not, however, require repeated trials with per-case pass rates, clearly separate evidence-based judges for every trial, or diagnosis of new misses followed by a repeated diagnose-revise-full-sweep loop. Therefore the evidence is insufficient to claim the fix worked under all criteria.","safety_regression":false}
